caption: The drawing depicts a round decorative plate with a dark brown background and a border that features a pattern of light squiggles and loops in cream and gold tones. Inside the central area of the plate, there is a cream-colored house with a patterned, multicolored roof that includes geometric shapes in salmon, beige, and blue tones. The house has four windows with dark panes, a central door, and a chimney. To the left of the house, there is a large tree with a thick trunk and spreading branches, painted in muted shades of brown, blue, and green. Under the tree, there is a smaller structure, possibly a shed or porch, with two human figures under it. The ground around the house is decorated with green and blue foliage and plant motifs, and there are stylized bushes and trees with brownish-orange spherical tops surrounding the house. The plate is set against a light beige rectangular background, and in the lower right corner outside the plate, there is a signature reading "E.H. Shaffer, 39."
title: Pa. German Deep Dish
